items.title: Radiohead Announce 2027 Shows In Australia & Japan
items.summary: Ed O'Brien was telling the truth. Back when the Radiohead guitarist announced his solo album Blue Morpho , he revealed that his longtime bandmates had developed a plan for touring going forward. In 2025, Radiohead played their first shows in seven years , a series of multi-show residencies in European cities. O'Brien explained that they'd like to keep doing that every year starting in 2027, choosing a different continent each time. Now we know where they're headed next year.
